claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no full text). The abstract claims that FoLap, a one-hidden-layer network that learns and predicts design-function updates online, saves up to 65.1% of total computing time for a soft-actuator cell design versus level-set and moving-isosurface-threshold TO.
